record.original_question: Extend the action-angle theorem in a neighbourhood of a Liou ville torus at singular points of the Poisson structure for splittable integrable s ystems. We suspect that either stability of the transversal part of the Po isson manifold or the existence of associated toric actions will play a role in solving this problem for specia l classes of Poisson manifolds. This problem can be extended to its global version. Can we find action -angle coordinates globally? This problem was considered by Duistermaat in the symplectic case [68 ]. One of the main ingredients in his construction was the affine structure defined by the action va riables on the image of the moment map. In the regular Poisson setting, the image of the moment map is f oliated by affine manifolds. Understanding this foliation is a key point to understanding global ob structions. The following problem has been partially considered in [76].

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(M,\pi)$ be a Poisson manifold of dimension $n$ and let $F=(f_1,\dots,f_s):M\to\mathbb{R}^s$ be an integrable system on $(M,\pi)$ in the sense that the components $f_i$ pairwise Poisson-commute and define, on the regular part, a foliation by isotropic tori of maximal dimension. Assume the system is "splittable" at a point $p\in M$: in a neighbourhood of $p$ the Poisson structure $\pi$ admits a Weinstein-type splitting into a symplectic factor and a transverse Poisson factor that is compatible with the integrable system $F$, and assume that $p$ lies on a compact regular fibre (Liouville torus) of $F$ but is a singular point of the Poisson structure $\pi$ (i.e., the rank of $\pi$ drops at $p$).

(a) (Local problem.) Establish an action–angle theorem in a neighbourhood of the Liouville torus through $p$: find coordinates $(\theta_1,\dots,\theta_r, p_1,\dots,p_r, z_1,\dots,z_{n-2r})$ in a tubular neighbourhood of the torus, where $\theta_i$ are angle coordinates on the torus, $p_i$ are action coordinates conjugate to the $\theta_i$, and the $z_j$ are transverse coordinates, in which $\pi$ takes a normal form and $F$ depends only on $(p_1,\dots,p_r,z_1,\dots,z_{n-2r})$. Identify the precise hypotheses (for example, stability of the transverse Poisson structure, or the existence of an associated effective torus action preserving $F$) under which such coordinates exist for natural classes of Poisson manifolds.

(b) (Global problem.) On a regular Poisson manifold $(M,\pi)$ carrying an integrable system $F$, the image of the moment-type map $F$ is foliated by affine manifolds carrying integral affine structures coming from action variables on each symplectic leaf. Determine the obstructions (cohomological/monodromy/Chern-class-type invariants associated with this affine foliation) to the existence of global action–angle coordinates, in analogy with Duistermaat's symplectic obstruction theory.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem appears still open in full generality. Local action–angle theorems exist for regular Poisson manifolds (Laurent-Gengoux–Miranda–Vanhaecke) and for b-symplectic/b^m-symplectic and singular symplectic settings, and partial results exist for non-commutative integrable systems and for systems near specific singular Poisson points, but a general action–angle theorem at singular points of the Poisson structure for splittable integrable systems, together with a global obstruction theory extending Duistermaat's symplectic result to the Poisson setting, has not been established.

status_evidence.title: Action-angle coordinates for integrable systems on Poisson manifolds
status_evidence.snippet: Action-angle coordinates established in a neighbourhood of a standard Liouville torus on regular Poisson manifolds.
status_evidence.claim: Provides the regular Poisson action–angle theorem, leaving the singular Poisson case open.

status_evidence.title: Integrable systems on singular symplectic manifolds: from local to global
status_evidence.snippet: Action-angle coordinates around regular Liouville tori for b-integrable systems on singular symplectic manifolds.
status_evidence.claim: Addresses related singular settings but not the general splittable Poisson singular case.

status_evidence.title: A Conceptual Approach to the Problem of Action-Angle Variables
status_evidence.snippet: General framework recovering Arnold–Liouville–Mineur and new results near singularities and in various geometric contexts.
status_evidence.claim: Provides partial progress but does not fully resolve the global Poisson obstruction problem.
